method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: list_programacao
tools.title: TV guide channels
tools.description: Channels with a collected TV guide, up to 48 per page.

q.description: Search in the channel name across the whole collection, up to 80 characters.

depois.description: Exclusive ID of the last row; use `proximo`.

tools.name: get_programacao
tools.title: Channel TV guide
tools.description: The last TV guide available for the channel and up to 20 dates of its history.

slug.description: The stored slug of the channel, from the collection.

antes.description: Exclusive day to page through the earlier days; use `guia.proximo`.

tools.name: get_programacao_dia
tools.title: Channel TV guide for a day
tools.description: The stored TV guide of a channel on one day.

slug.description: The stored slug of the channel, from the collection.

antes.description: Exclusive day to page through the earlier days; use `guia.proximo`.

annotations.title: Channel TV guide for a day

tools.name: api_index
tools.title: API index
tools.description: The index of the whole API, with the languages and the HTML pages of each language.

tools.name: health
tools.title: Service health
tools.description: Liveness and the commit that is published now. The smoke test waits for its own deploy here.

tools.name: geo
tools.title: Suggested country and language
tools.description: The country and the language suggested for the caller. When the edge detects no country, it suggests BR with `source: "fallback"`; `detected` tells what the edge saw.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.title: Countries
tools.description: The countries in the catalog, with the playable count and the flag URL (`kind=radio` counts stations).

kind.description: `tv` (default) counts TV channels; `radio` counts radio stations; `all` counts both.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.title: Radio tags
tools.description: The tags of the playable radio stations, with the count, optionally by country.

country.description: Limits to the stations of one country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

limit.description: How many tags to return (100 at most).

tools.name: search_channels
tools.title: Search channels
tools.description: Searches public channels (filters: q, country, category, language, network, quality, playable; kind=radio for radio stations, tag for a radio tag; sort=score orders by the health that a third party measures, sort=votes by the radio votes; online=1 returns only channels seen online in the last 48 h). This is the main entry point of the product. The response changes with the browser, the system and the country of the caller: each channel has `social.your_fails`, the result for YOUR environment, so the response is `Cache-Control: private`.

q.description: Free text in the channel name and its aliases (full-text search).

country.description: Country of the channel, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

network.description: Exact name of the network or broadcaster.

guide.description: `1` returns only channels with a TV guide (EPG).

playable.description: `0` also includes channels with no known usable stream.

sort.description: `score` orders by the health that a third party measures, best first; channels with no measurement go to the end. `votes` orders by the votes recorded for the station (radio). `name` is alphabetical order.

online.description: `1` returns only channels that the source saw online in the 48 h before the last catalog reload (`health_ext.online`). When the catalog has not reloaded for more than 48 h, the filter returns no channel.

kind.description: `tv` (default) is the TV catalog; `radio` is the radio stations; `all` is both. Without `kind`, radio never appears.

tag.description: Radio station tag (free vocabulary, for example `mpb` or `news`); see `GET /api/tags`.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.title: Languages
tools.description: The languages that have a playable channel, with the count of each language.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.title: Networks
tools.description: The networks and broadcasters that have a playable channel, with the count.

tools.name: list_qualities
tools.title: Stream qualities
tools.description: The different qualities found in the catalog streams (for radio, the codec and the bitrate).

tools.name: list_subdivisions
tools.title: States and provinces
tools.description: The states and provinces that have a playable channel.

country.description: Limits to one country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.title: Cities
tools.description: The cities that have a playable channel. You can filter them by country and by state.

country.description: Limits to one country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

subdivision.description: Limits to one state or province.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.title: Get a channel
tools.description: The full record of a channel, with the streams that already point to our hop.

id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: get_channel_guide
tools.title: Today's channel guide
tools.description: Today's TV guide of the channel (recorded by us): now, next and the list. It is available for the channels with a guide (`guide=1`) and is valid for up to two days. Check the date of the response; the channel record has the summary in `guide_now`.

id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: create_guest
tools.title: Create a guest
tools.description: Creates a guest `ipt_…`. It asks for no e-mail and no other data. Keep the token: if you lose the token, you lose the library, unless an account already claimed it (`POST /api/auth/claim`). Then the account keeps what the token saved.

tools.name: get_library
tools.title: Library
tools.description: The whole library of the owner: folders, tabs, channels and the feed URLs of each level.

tools.name: create_category
tools.title: Create a folder
tools.description: Creates a personal folder (category). 8 folders at most per owner. The response has the whole updated library, so you do not need to reload `GET /api/library`.

tools.name: create_group
tools.title: Create a tab
tools.description: Creates a tab in a folder. 12 tabs at most per folder. The response has the whole updated library, so you do not need to reload `GET /api/library`.

tools.name: add_item
tools.title: Add a channel to a tab
tools.description: Adds a channel to a tab. 40 channels at most per tab. The response tells the folder and the tab where the channel went, so the screen opens in the right place. The response has the whole updated library, so you do not need to reload `GET /api/library`.

channel_id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

annotations.title: Add a channel to a tab

tools.name: get_history
tools.title: Watch history
tools.description: The channels that the owner watched. It shows only the channels that are available in the catalog.

limit.description: Items per page. A value above 50 becomes 50.

offset.description: How many items to skip. Use `next_offset` from the previous response.

tools.name: record_watch
tools.title: Record a watched channel
tools.description: Records a watched channel in the owner's history.

tools.name: forget_watch
tools.title: Remove from the history
tools.description: Removes a channel from the owner's history.

channel_id.description: Channel to remove from the history, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: clear_history
tools.title: Clear the history
tools.description: Clears the whole history of the owner at once.

tools.name: tv_state
tools.title: TV network activation
tools.description: Checks the activation of the TV network by the six-digit code.

codigo.description: The six digits shown on the TV screen. They are valid for ten minutes.

tools.name: legacy_stream
tools.title: Legacy stream
tools.description: Public metadata: the official site of the channel, the stream URL to copy into another player, and the legacy HTTP player. The legacy_url button opens http://legacy.gradetv.net/legacy?stream=ID, with no port in the address. The standalone page accepts lang=pt/en/es/fr/de/hu and theme=light/dark. Playlists go through the HTTPS hop, and the media comes directly from the origin. It does not remove an access refusal or a CORS requirement. It is one indexed read: it does not fetch the origin and does not write to the database.

id.description: Public stream ID, including the old IDs for compatibility.

tools.name: producer_services
tools.title: Services for producers
tools.description: Authorized broadcast offer on request: information and contacts for producers. It does not turn on streams; it only gives information and collects interest. To present a project, use contact.form_url in the browser, contact.email by e-mail, or POST /api/contact.

lang.description: Language of the offer: pt, en, es, fr, de or hu. A missing or unknown value falls back to pt.

tools.name: report_play
tools.title: Report a play
tools.description: Reports whether a channel played (ok=true) or not (ok=false with code). The browser and the system come from the User-Agent, and the country comes from the request data; the body cannot change them. The first report of a result on a day returns 201. It counts once per owner, channel, day and result; a repeat returns 200 with `reason: ja_relatado_hoje`. The reports help to compare results in `GET /api/channels/:id/health`, but they do not confirm the cause of a failure.

channel_id.description: The channel that you tried to watch.

ok.description: `true` when it played, `false` when it failed.

code.description: Failure code, only when `ok` is `false`. A missing or unknown code counts as `outro`.

tools.name: play_reports
tools.title: Raw play reports
tools.description: The raw reports of a channel, with the address. Operator only (METRICS_TOKEN). Use it to investigate one channel. In the current reports, the `ip` field has an identifier calculated from the network and a secret value. The retention period is in `retention_days`. The public panel does not return this identifier.

ok.description: `0` returns only the failures, which is the subset for an investigation.

limit.description: Items per page. A value above 50 becomes 50.

tools.name: channel_health
tools.title: Channel health
tools.description: The community health of the channel: the success rate, the failure reasons and the affected environments. It tells 'the channel is off the air' from 'the channel is blocked in your country'. `geo` tells whether it is a regional restriction or a general failure (with the countries), `regions[]` has the success and the failure by country, `latency[]` has the opening speed measured at the hop by country, and `pra_voce` sums it up for the country of the caller. Without community reports (`POST /api/play-report`), the panel is empty.

id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.title: Favorites
tools.description: The favorites of the owner. It shows only the channels that are available in the catalog.

tools.name: add_favorite
tools.title: Add a favorite
tools.description: Marks a channel as a favorite. A repeat does not add up: the public counter counts people, not clicks.

channel_id.description: Channel to mark as a favorite, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.title: Remove a favorite
tools.description: Removes the channel from the favorites and gives the point back to the public counter.

channel_id.description: Channel to remove from the favorites, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.title: Channel comments
tools.description: The community comments about a channel. When the call has a credential, each of your comments has `mine: true`; this is how the interface knows what you can delete.

id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: post_comment
tools.title: Post a comment
tools.description: Comments on a channel (20 per hour at most per owner). Without `author`, the server makes a nickname that stays the same for the same owner, so the person does not get a different name for each message.

id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

body.description: The comment text. The limit is in `max_length` of the list.

author.description: Nickname to use; without it, the server makes a stable one.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.title: Delete a comment
tools.description: Deletes a comment of the owner. The 404 is on purpose: the API does not confirm that a comment with that id exists when it is not yours.

tools.name: chat_history
tools.title: Chat history
tools.description: The last messages in the room of a channel (without WebSocket).

channel_id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

tools.name: chat_send
tools.title: Send a chat message
tools.description: Sends a message to the room of a channel by HTTP. The speaker is the guest (`X-Guest-Token`), the same one that the WebSocket recognizes; without a guest, the account session.

channel_id.description: Channel ID in the catalog, for example `GloboNews.br`.

author.description: Nickname to use; without it, the server makes a stable one.

tools.name: me
tools.title: Account
tools.description: The session account (the cookie that the MCP client passes on): the e-mail and the size of the account library. `user.id` is the account id, and the account owns the library when there is a session.

tools.name: contact
tools.title: Contact
tools.description: Write to the people behind the product: a question, or a sponsorship/partnership/advertising proposal. One route for a question and for a sponsorship, partnership or ad proposal (`tipo`, with the placements of `GET /api/partners`). One message every 10 seconds per network: one that arrives sooner waits its turn and then goes out — no error. The message reaches the team by e-mail, with `email` as the reply address. For voice, send multipart/form-data: `dados` is this JSON (up to 32 KiB), and `audio` is one WebM, Ogg or M4A audio file (up to 2 MB). Audio can replace message. The browser records up to two minutes. Audio is attached to the owner's e-mail.

name.description: What to call the person writing.

whatsapp.description: Optional reply number with country code, such as +5561999999999.

prefer_whatsapp.description: Request a WhatsApp reply. Requires whatsapp.

tipo.description: Proposal: `patrocinio`, `parceria`, `anuncio` or `consultoria`. Turns on the fields below.

empresa.description: Who is proposing, when it is a company.

orcamento.description: Advertising: `ate_100`, `100_500`, `500_2000`, `2000_mais` or `a_combinar`. Consulting, in US dollars: `ate_2000`, `2000_5000`, `5000_10000`, `10000_mais` or `nao_sei`.

projeto.description: Consulting: the kind of project (`llm_privado`, `voz`, `dados_sensiveis`, `gpu`, `integracao` or `outro`).

pais.description: Consulting: the country of the person asking.

fuso.description: Consulting: the IANA time zone, such as `America/New_York`.

horarios.description: Consulting: up to 3 times for the call, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM` in that time zone.
